summary: Inovio Pharmaceuticals filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (424B5) for a primary underwritten offering of common stock under its existing July 2026 shelf registration. Terms remain blank: share count, public offering price, underwriting discount and net proceeds are all left unspecified, with Jefferies and Piper Sandler named joint book-running managers. Reference price is $1.62 as of November 4, 2026, on the Nasdaq Capital Market under INO. A 30-day underwriters' option covers additional shares. This is a routine shelf takedown of equity, not a special situation; dilution and pricing risk are the only watch items.
